findings.claim: The supplied files do not support the assertion that every route enforces authorization: health() in auth_routes.py has no authorization check, whereas profile(session) enforces authorization via a session guard. auth_routes.py:5-8 -> def profile(session): if not session: raise PermissionError("missing session"); return "profile" (authorization enforced)
README.txt:1-2 -> 'These are two example routes supplied for a bounded review. They are not a complete route inventory.'
caveats: Bounded to the two supplied fixture files only; not a complete route inventory.
Does not establish a production-wide authentication bypass; the fixture is explicitly an example set, not a production inventory.
Production-wide safety is not established by these files either.
